selection_objective: pooled validation held-out users support lengths 1,3,5 NDCG@20; same user may have multiple support queries

100.status: fewer than 30 validation queries; use pooled winner

candidate_strategy: full training-user-selected eligible item universe, no sampled negatives; all support games excluded; other unobserved items are ranking distractors, not explicit dislikes
long_tail_definition: training-positive count at/below 80th percentile among eligible items
ci_method: 200 user/query bootstrap samples, percentile 95%; pooled validation repeated users not independent
limitations: Historical Steam review-selection bias; not a probability of real-world enjoyment
Item-universe restriction omits cold and low-count items
Metadata snapshot is static and may postdate historical interactions
Warm holdout tests item fold-in; no per-user stored latent vectors
Single seeded split; no significance claim from overlapping confidence intervals

dataset.license: CC0: Public Domain (publisher declaration in Kaggle API)

data_cohort_selection: numeric source user_id % 32 == 0; complete selected histories
